FWC Lionfish Challenge celebrates 10-year anniversary with this year’s winners! | FWC Skip to main content Buy and Apply Recreational Fishing & Hunting How to Order Do I Need a License? Limited Entry/Quota Hunts Public Land Use Accessibility Accommodations Commercial Commercial Licenses Commercial S … d on 1,104 dive trips to remove over 30,000 invasive lionfish during the summer-long tournament. Participants raced to collect the most lionfish and turn them in at statewide checkpoints. The more lionfish submitted, the more prizes divers received. Paul Carlson of Palm Beach County earned the prestigious title of Lionfish King in the Recreational Division by removing 1,542 lionfish over 73 dive trips. Kris Anderson of Texas followed closely with 1,098 lionfish removed over 36 trips to earn second place. Helen Rodney, from Broward County, won third place by removing 962 lionfish.
